name: J.Lindeberg
why: The house that dragged golf clothing into fashion — Stockholm design language applied to the course and the slope.
origin: Johan Lindeberg, Stockholm, 1996 — built its name dressing tour players in clothes cut like fashion rather than like kit.
opview: The founding argument was that golf clothes had no reason to be shapeless, and the tour was the place to prove it.

onething.n: the garment the house made its name on, cut narrow when the rest of the category was not. NO LINK — no US-facing product page verified in this pass

notes.scandi: Swedish by origin, but the register it trades in is golf rather than Nordic minimalism — a passport without the accent
notes.golf: the tour was the launch strategy, and the pro shop is still the native channel
notes.ski: a real winter line beside the golf book rather than a capsule

cities: Own stores in Scandinavia; US reach through golf specialty and department stores
